dataset_description: A dataset of discrete variables influencing Neisseria gonorrhoeae antibiotic susceptibility test (AST) initiation in Australia, collected from 2002 to 2022.

ASTTest.description: Antibiotic susceptibility test initiation status ( "Initiated" | "Not initiated" )

ClinicianExperience.description: Clinical experience of the clinician with sexual health ( "Experienced" | "Unexperienced" )

EpidemiologicalFactors.description: Population level epidemiological risk factors ( "High Risk Group" | "Low Risk Group" )

InitialTreatmentFailure.description: Status of initial treatment outcome ( "Treatment success" | "Treatment failure" )

MedicationAdherence.description: Individual level medication adherence ( "Proper Adherence" | "Improper Adherence" )

NumberPartners.description: Number of sexual partners an individual presents with ( "One" | "Two to five" | "More than six" )

PastDiagnoses.description: Number of past diagnoses an individual presents with ( "One" | "Two to four" | "Five to nine" | "More than ten" )

PersistingSymptoms.description: Individual level persistence of symptoms ( "Symptoms persist" | "Symptoms resolve" )

UnpromptedTest.description: Unprompted test accounting for the possibility of a test being initiated regardless of any factors ( "Initiated" | "Not initiated" )
